category_edits.rationale: Add pairwise ranking supervision to the existing BCE objective using the same valid sampled pairs. The 0.2-weighted term may improve HR@10 while preserving the architecture, inference, sampling, optimizer, and host-configured 200-epoch cap.

edits.find:
loss = bce_criterion(pos_logits[indices], pos_labels)
            loss = loss + bce_criterion(neg_logits[indices], neg_labels)
edits.replace:
loss = bce_criterion(pos_logits[indices], pos_labels)
            loss = loss + bce_criterion(neg_logits[indices], neg_labels)
            pairwise_loss = nn.functional.softplus(
                neg_logits[indices] - pos_logits[indices]
            ).mean()
            loss = loss + 0.2 * pairwise_loss

change_summary: Add 0.2 times mean softplus(s_neg - s_pos) over valid training positions to the original BCE loss. Predictor and checkpoint formats remain compatible.
